metadata.coverage: Every one of the film's 13 dialogue-free gaps carries at least one description. Gap 0 was written by hand from frames; gaps 1-12 were written by Amazon Nova Pro from frames extracted at the exact timestamps named in each frameRef. Two gaps (1 at 3.25s and 9 at 4.70s) are shorter than their line takes to speak; the player refuses those at runtime rather than talking over the dialogue that follows.

review.method: Every Bedrock-written line was read next to the frame it was written from.
review.note: Corrected entries keep the model wording in draftText with the reason, so the model's unaided accuracy stays auditable.

continuity.method: Offline referent normalisation. No model call, no new observation. Each edited line keeps its original wording in continuityFrom.
continuity.scheme: Introduce by appearance once; one fixed short form thereafter; the name "Sintel" only from 457.8s, the moment the film first speaks it.
notNormalised: sintel-ad-25 - "a gaunt woman" is a different character, not the protagonist.
All dragon references - the small dragon and the large creature are not established as the same animal by any reviewed frame, so neither is renamed "Scales".
